target.title: fix(agents): reject with AbortError when tool execution is cancelled
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a tool execution is cancelled via the agent's AbortSignal, onAbortSignal calls run.kill() to terminate the child process — but the outer Promise resolved normally with the process exit code. The agent manager was misled into believing the tool finished normally, causing it to keep executing steps with dead process output.

## Why This Change Was Made

The process exit handler always called resolve(buildExecForegroundResult(...)) regardless of whether the exit was caused by an abort signal. Additionally, the yield timer remained armed after abort, creating a race where it could resolve the promise with a "running" result before the killed-process exit handler could reject it.

## User Impact

- Cancel/stop during bash tool execution now correctly aborts the agent run
- Yield timer race is eliminated: abort atomically clears the timer + kills the process
- Backgrounded and yielded sessions remain unaffected

## Evidence

### Real Exec Tool Transcript (3/3 scenarios)

```
$ npx tsx proof/abort-exec-proof.ts

================================================================
 ABORT BEHAVIOR PROOF — REAL EXEC TOOL
 PID: 151586  Time: 2026-07-13 06:46:38
================================================================

--- 1. Normal execution completes normally ---
  Output: hello world

--- 2. Abort during execution -> rejects with AbortError ---
  ✅ REJECTED: DOMException - Tool execution was aborted

--- 3. Yield timer + abort -> rejects (timer cleared) ---
  ✅ REJECTED: DOMException - Tool execution was aborted

================================================================
 ABORT BEHAVIOR CONFIRMED — 3/3 scenarios
================================================================
```

### Unit Tests (35/35 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts --reporter=verbose
 ✓ suppresses onUpdate after abort signal fires
 ✓ rejects with AbortError when abort fires before yield window expires
 ✓ ... (33 other tests)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  35 passed (35)
```

### Lint + Format
```
$ npx oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts
  No errors
$ npx oxfmt --check src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts
  All matched files use the correct format
```

## What Changed

- src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts: +13 lines (toolAborted flag + clear yieldTimer + AbortError rejection)
- src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts: +23 lines (regression test for yield timer race)

Fixes #105681
